title: reg_f3d
description: Fast Free-Form Deformation algorithm for non-rigid registration based on Rueckert's 99 TMI work.

reference_mask.title: Reference Mask Image

spacing_x.description: Final grid spacing along the x axis in mm (or in voxel if negative value)

linear_elasticity.description: Weights of linear elasticity penalty term

l2_norm_displacement.description: Weight of L2 norm displacement penalty term
l2_norm_displacement.title: L2 Norm Displacement Penalty Term Weight

jacobian_determinant.description: Weight of log of the Jacobian determinant penalty term
jacobian_determinant.title: Log of the Jacobian Determinant Penalty Term Weight

max_iterations.description: Maximal number of iterations per level
